statements.statement: The service denied was mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229)
The denial reason code was PR-204
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The service was rejected because mobile cardiac telemetry is not covered under the beneficiary's current benefit plan
